issues.legal_issue: A request to recall a witness after consolidation must be considered in light of the witness’s procedural status and the treatment of testimony already recorded.
material_facts: Related suits concerning the same property were consolidated after the appellant had given evidence and been cross-examined, and that evidence had been closed.
The respondents sought a fresh examination or another opportunity to cross-examine, relying on the effect of consolidation on their opportunity to cross-examine the appellant.

The appellant had ceased to be a party to one of the suits, and the court had maintained consolidation while treating the evidence already recorded in the appellant’s suit as evidence in the main suit.
The trial court and the High Court did not account for those procedural circumstances when making the orders under challenge.
issues.conclusion: The Court set aside the impugned order and allowed the appeal. It did not decide the general permissibility of recalling a witness under Order 18 Rule 17 CPC; it directed the trial court to dispose of the suits expeditiously.
issues.legal_principle: The Court relied on the procedural circumstances recorded in the orders concerning consolidation, the appellant’s status as a party, and the treatment of her previously recorded evidence. Although the recall application invoked Order 18 Rule 17 CPC and Section 51 CPC, the Court expressly declined to decide the broader question of when recall is permissible under Order 18 Rule 17. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: appeal_from_witness_recall_order and related_suits_consolidated and prior_testimony_recorded and witness_no_longer_party_to_related_suit and prior_testimony_treated_as_main_suit and recall_request_based_on_cross_examination_opportunity

predicates.appeal_from_witness_recall_order: A party appealed an order concerning a request to recall or re-examine a witness.
predicates.related_suits_consolidated: The court ordered related suits to be heard together or consolidated.
predicates.prior_testimony_recorded: The witness had already given testimony in one of the related suits before the consolidation order.
predicates.witness_no_longer_party_to_related_suit: The witness was no longer a party to the related suit in which the recall request’s asserted cross-examination opportunity arose.
predicates.prior_testimony_treated_as_main_suit: The court directed that the testimony already recorded in one suit be treated as evidence in the main suit.
predicates.recall_request_based_on_cross_examinatio: The recall request asserted that consolidation affected a party’s opportunity to cross-examine the witness.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns a witness-recall order in consolidated related suits, the witness’s earlier testimony is treated as evidence in the main suit, the witness is no longer a party to the related suit, and the recall request rests on an asserted loss of cross-examination opportunity, the challenged order is set aside.
